question: The Head of an Indian state is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The governor** is **the constitutional head of a state in India.**
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India for a term of five years.
 
• The Governor has the power to appoint the Chief Minister and other members of the State Council of Ministers.
